findings.title: MAIF did not verify that invoice billing rates for certain contractual services agreed to contract terms.
findings.description: MAIF did not verify billing rates from information system contractual services invoices to related contract terms. Review of five contracts totaling approximately $3 million disclosed billings related to one $1.5 million contract were not verified. MAIF made various overpayments and underpayments for these services, collectively totaling approximately $133,000.

dollar_amounts.context: $1.5 million contract for information retrieval services

findings.recommendation: verify all billing rates to contract terms, and review all past invoices from the aforementioned vendor and take appropriate action for any payment discrepancies noted.

findings.title: There was no documented verification that all recorded collections were subsequently deposited.
findings.description: MAIF did not have a documented deposit verification process. Collections received in the form of checks were independently verified but the verification was not documented. MAIF’s check collections totaled approximately $24.1 million in calendar year 2011.
findings.recommendation: document the independent verification of collections received to deposit.

extraction.agency_response_summary: The report states that MAIF’s response to findings and recommendations is included as an appendix.
